item.text:
The schema change is ready against the repository contracts. [schema.sql](/private/var/folders/vv/rc3f4h3505jfy6qnq3w7m93w0000gn/T/harness-eval-n7KhKF/workspace/schema.sql) now protects audit records from updates, deletes, and truncation. The demo-account purge uses a dedicated non-login owner and checks for unhandled restrictive foreign keys before deleting data.

The PostgreSQL 18 checks in [test.sql](/private/var/folders/vv/rc3f4h3505jfy6qnq3w7m93w0000gn/T/harness-eval-n7KhKF/workspace/test.sql) passed. They cover completion records, real-account preservation, demo purging, foreign-key diagnosis, role isolation, and refusal of direct audit deletion after the app sets a custom flag.
